request: 大型 Markdown 文档编辑时容易卡死；预览目录标题需要随文档滚动同步并改为紧凑纵向；Markdown 导出 PDF 需要修复代码/表格边框、Mermaid/流程图发黑、图片宽度超页和页面适配。Issue: #792.
initial_status: Isolated worktree based on clean origin/main 572f5dfd32bd8587efb99030409b9859fef36690; unrelated user working tree was left untouched.
acceptance: Editing a representative large Markdown fixture must not synchronously rerender/rehighlight the full document on every keystroke; visible editing remains responsive and preview has a clear bounded update policy.
Preview outline is a compact vertical list and tracks the heading at the reading position while scrolling up and down; section links still navigate correctly.
PDF export preserves table/code borders and Mermaid flowchart colors, constrains images and other wide content to the printable area without aspect distortion, and does not clip page edges.
Run focused automated checks and inspect exported PDF pages in a real browser; report both evidence types and limits separately.

requirements.summary: Issue #792 records the four reported symptoms without user document content; the requirements separate editor responsiveness, outline behavior, PDF visual style, and page fitting.

design.summary: Live edits above 512 KiB now avoid repeated synchronous full-document parse/render; large preview requires explicit generation. Heading activation uses binary search. PDF export uses explicit readable print borders and limits SVG style loss by inlining computed paint for strict export, with max-width constraints for page content.

implementation.summary: Added a 512 KiB large-document deferred preview policy, a compact vertical outline with binary-search scroll activation, and print-snapshot styles for borders, responsive images, color-preserving Mermaid SVG and page-aware heading breaks.
